# `courtlistener_bankruptcy_dockets`

**CourtListener bankruptcy dockets (2022 export)**

Historical U.S. bankruptcy court docket metadata from CourtListener's one-off 2022-09-19 bulk export, typed natively with `DATE`, UTC `TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE`, and `BOOLEAN` columns while preserving identifier strings and publisher NULL-versus-empty-string distinctions verbatim. Unlike `court_dockets` (which selects Administrative Procedure Act cases), this table covers federal bankruptcy districts captured by CourtListener's `court_id LIKE '%b'` export predicate. For strictly federal bankruptcy district totals, filter `court_id NOT IN ('neb', 'mspb', 'pactcomplcolumb', 'paorphctcolumb', 'nyoytermctalb')`. `cl_docket_id` matches `court_opinion_clusters.cl_docket_id`, though most PACER bankruptcy dockets have no published opinion.

**Coverage.** Not a range. One archival CourtListener bulk export cut 2022-09-19 from the publisher's `search_docket` table under a `court_id LIKE '%b'` predicate rather than a strict federal bankruptcy court filter. Includes federal bankruptcy district courts whose court code ends in `b`, plus five non-bankruptcy spillover courts (`neb` Nebraska Supreme Court, `mspb` Merit Systems Protection Board, `pactcomplcolumb`, `paorphctcolumb`, and `nyoytermctalb`). All eight Bankruptcy Appellate Panels (`bap1`, `bap2`, `bap6`, `bap8`, `bap9`, `bap10`, `bapma`, `bapme`) and `tennesseeb` are absent. Static historical snapshot cut off at 2022-09-19 and never refreshed incrementally. *(measured 2026-11-28)*

**Data quality.** Measured 2026-11-28 across all 34,653,306 rows of the 2022-09-19 export and reconciled against PostgreSQL 16 `file_fdw`. Because CourtListener exported `WHERE court_id LIKE '%b'`, 65,365 rows belong to five non-bankruptcy courts (`neb`: 62,576; `mspb`: 2,590; `pactcomplcolumb`: 180; `paorphctcolumb`: 11; `nyoytermctalb`: 8), all retained verbatim for Layer 1 fidelity, while all 8 Bankruptcy Appellate Panels (`bap1`, `bap2`, `bap6`, `bap8`, `bap9`, `bap10`, `bapma`, `bapme`) and `tennesseeb` are absent. On `docket_number`, PostgreSQL SQL NULL (2,598 rows: 2,590 `mspb`, 7 `neb`, 1 `flmb`) is kept strictly distinct from empty string `""` (4,241 rows: 4,224 `neb`, 12 `pactcomplcolumb`, 5 `nyoytermctalb`). `pacer_case_id` preserves 6 literal non-numeric strings (`"null"` in 5 rows, `"undefined"` in 1 row) alongside 73,563 SQL NULLs without coercion, and `docket_number_core` preserves 10,239,468 leading-zero values as text. Clerical date outliers are retained verbatim as `DATE` in `date_filed` (`1871-10-12` to `2079-11-23`; 1 row before 1900 and 45 after `2022-09-19`) and `date_terminated` (`0205-02-25` to `2097-02-13`; 7 rows before 1900 and 16 after `2022-09-19`); `date_blocked` spans `2013-10-29` to `2022-09-19` with zero out-of-range dates, though 266 rows have `blocked` and `date_blocked` populated independently. `referred_to_id` is 100% SQL NULL and `referred_to_str` is 100% empty string `""`; `case_name` retains literal PACER HTML tags, truncated entities, and backslashes as published.

- **Parquet file:** `courtlistener_bankruptcy_dockets.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cl_docket_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener docket ID (source column `id`), stored as canonical positive integer text matching `court_dockets.cl_docket_id` and `court_opinion_clusters.cl_docket_id`. Primary key within the 2022-09-19 export. |
| `court_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener court code (e.g. `flmb`, `txsb`, `nysb`). Covers 94 federal bankruptcy districts plus five non-bankruptcy spillover codes (`neb`, `mspb`, `pactcomplcolumb`, `paorphctcolumb`, `nyoytermctalb`) matched by `court_id LIKE '%b'`. |
| `docket_number` | `VARCHAR` | Court docket number as recorded by CourtListener (e.g. `1:15-bk-00281`, `02-05494`). Keeps SQL NULL strictly distinct from empty string `""` as emitted by PostgreSQL. |
| `docket_number_core` | `VARCHAR` | Normalized numeric core of the docket number (`VARCHAR`, preserving leading zeros such as `02015759`); empty string `""` when not populated. |
| `pacer_case_id` | `VARCHAR` | PACER CM/ECF case identifier as text (`VARCHAR`), matching `court_dockets.pacer_case_id`. SQL NULL when absent; literal publisher strings `"null"` and `"undefined"` are kept verbatim. |
| `case_name` | `VARCHAR` | Case caption as published by CourtListener (`VARCHAR`). Retains literal PACER HTML annotations, backslashes, and empty string `""` where blank. |
| `case_name_short` | `VARCHAR` | Short case caption (`VARCHAR`); empty string `""` when not populated, and literal strings such as `"NULL"` or `"N/A"` are preserved verbatim. |
| `case_name_full` | `VARCHAR` | Full case caption (`VARCHAR`); empty string `""` on the vast majority of rows. |
| `date_filed` | `DATE` | Date the docket was filed (`DATE`, nullable). Retains publisher clerical outliers before 1900 and after `2022-09-19` verbatim. |
| `date_terminated` | `DATE` | Date the docket was terminated (`DATE`, nullable for open or unrecorded cases). Retains publisher clerical outliers as early as `0205-02-25` and as late as `2097-02-13` verbatim. |
| `assigned_to_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener judge person ID (`VARCHAR`, nullable), matching CourtListener's `people_db_person.id` and `court_opinions.author_id`. |
| `assigned_to_str` | `VARCHAR` | Assigned judge display name as literal publisher text (`VARCHAR`); empty string `""` when unpopulated. |
| `referred_to_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener referred judge person ID (`VARCHAR`, nullable). Retained for Layer 1 schema fidelity; 100% SQL NULL in the 2022-09-19 export. |
| `referred_to_str` | `VARCHAR` | Referred judge display name (`VARCHAR`). Retained for Layer 1 schema fidelity; 100% empty string `""` in the 2022-09-19 export. |
| `blocked` | `BOOLEAN` | Boolean flag (`BOOLEAN`) indicating whether CourtListener marked the docket blocked from search indexing (converted from canonical PostgreSQL `'t'`/`'f'`). |
| `date_blocked` | `DATE` | Date CourtListener marked the docket blocked (`DATE`, nullable). |
| `date_created` | `TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE` | UTC timestamp (`TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE`) when CourtListener created the docket record. |
| `date_modified` | `TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE` | UTC timestamp (`TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE`) when CourtListener last modified the docket record. |
| `dump_date` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener bulk export edition date (`'2022-09-19'`). |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest (`sha256:` and 64 hex digits) of the retained raw CourtListener `.csv.bz2` archive from which every row was decoded. |
